proposals.evidence: Full *sphuṭyati gives Prakrit phuṭṭaï “bursts” and phuṭṭa “burst”, Nepali phuṭnu, Maithili phūṭab “be broken”, Bhojpuri phūṭal, Odia phuṭibā and Marathi phuṭṇẽ. The selected survey responses preserve the phuṭ-/puṭ- break stem with regional infinitive or participial endings; these inflections do not warrant derived edges. Deaspiration and the source dental/retroflex spellings are retained. Responses with a separate go-auxiliary, unexplained material, or a different slash-separated stem are excluded.
